verdict.rationale: Asana's own docs show creating tasks through the API and its official MCP server, including creating and assigning tasks. Due dates are evidenced indirectly by the documented query for tasks due this week, which shows tasks carry due dates. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of setting due dates and assignees when creating a task (e.g., an API field reference), and independent hands-on corroboration of the assign-with-due-date workflow.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: Learn to create and authorize with a token then create tasks via the API.
